name: GSSEO Meta Generator
author: GAURI SHANKAR

sections.description:
This plugin connects to an API to obtain weather information, it’s needed to show the weather information and forecasts in the included widget.

It sends the user’s location every time the widget is loaded (If the location isn’t available and/or the user hasn’t given their consent, it displays a configurable default location).
This service is provided by “PRT Weather INC”: terms of use, privacy policy.

GSSEO Meta Generator Plugin helps you boost your website’s visibility on search engines by providing smart tools such as:

  • Bulk editing of Meta Titles and Descriptions
  • AI-based generation of SEO metadata
  • Compatibility with top SEO plugins like Yoast, Rank Math, AIOSEO, and SEOPress

Whether you’re an SEO expert or just starting out, GSSEO Meta Generator gives you the tools to improve your site’s ranking easily and efficiently.

External Services

This plugin uses the following external service:

Cohere API

  • Service: https://cohere.com/
  • API URL: https://api.cohere.ai/v1/generate
  • Purpose: Used to generate AI-powered meta titles and meta descriptions to help with SEO optimization.
  • Data Sent: The plugin sends post/page titles and content to the Cohere API in order to generate meta titles and descriptions.
  • Conditions: This action is performed only when the site administrator explicitly clicks the “Generate via AI” button in the plugin dashboard.
  • Terms of Service: https://cohere.com/terms-of-use
  • Privacy Policy: https://cohere.com/privacy

No user personal data is sent. Only post and page content created by the site administrator is transmitted for processing.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gsseo directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the GSSEO menu in your WordPress dashboard to configure the settings.
sections.faq:
Is GSSEO Meta Generator compatible with other SEO plugins?

Yes, GSSEO Meta Generator works alongside popular SEO plugins like Yoast, Rank Math, All in One SEO, and SEOPress.

Does this plugin support AI-powered features?

Yes, it supports AI-based generation of Meta Titles, Descriptions, and Internal Linking.

Can I use GSSEO Meta Generator to manage schema markup?

Absolutely. GSSEO Meta Generator includes a schema generator to help your content stand out in search results.
